lang.name: English
start.greeting: Hi, {name}! I'm an AI agent that analyzes your Telegram chats. What I can do: • find the right message among thousands • build channel statistics (views, reactions, growth) • summarize a chat and suggest post ideas • write, edit and pin posts I can never delete messages — this is structurally impossible. Connect an account to get started.
error.not_allowed: Sorry, this bot is private. You don't have access.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
help.text: Commands /start — main menu /accounts — connected accounts /lang — change language Security • Session keys are stored encrypted • The agent cannot delete messages • The agent cannot write to this bot • Every write action asks for your confirmation
web.title: tg-ai-analyzer
web.login.title: Connect a Telegram account
web.login.subtitle: Enter your phone number — Telegram will send a confirmation code. The code is entered only on this secure page; never type it into a chat.
web.login.code_hint.app: The code was sent to your Telegram app (another device).
web.login.code_hint.sms: The code was sent via SMS.
web.login.code_hint.call: The code will be dictated by a phone call.
web.login.password_hint: Your account has a cloud password enabled. Enter it.
web.login.security_note: Your session key is stored encrypted. The agent cannot delete messages and never writes anything without your confirmation.
web.login.tos_note: Userbot automation sits at the edge of Telegram's rules — the account may be limited.
web.chat.title: AI chat
web.chat.empty_state: Pick a Telegram chat on the left and ask: “What was discussed this week?”, “Which post got the most views?”, “3 ideas for the next post”.
web.chat.no_accounts: No account connected — connect a Telegram account first.
auth.err.phone_banned: This number is banned by Telegram.
auth.err.flood: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and retry.
auth.err.flow_expired: Timed out or session not found. Start over.
auth.err.code_expired: Code expired. Request a new one.
auth.err.signup_required: There is no Telegram account on this number.
pool.err.no_session: No session for this account — reconnect.
pool.err.flood: Telegram rate limit. Wait a bit.
chat.err.llm: The AI could not answer. Try again.
web.chat.sync_queued: Queued — give it a few minutes.
chat.err.not_synced: This chat isn't synced yet — up to 200 come live, or start a sync.
web.dash.title: Dashboard
web.dash.strategy_note: search — messages matching the question (FTS+vector); window — time window (large windows compacted by a cheap model); recent — latest.
